title: Permission expired
story: ShopBot tries to pay under a permission that ran out yesterday. The Guard blocks it with MANDATE_EXPIRED: no payment is made under an expired permission, and approving can't bring it back.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: Nothing was fast-forwarded and nothing was edited: Asha's permission was granted for a period that ended yesterday, and the Guard's fixed rule compares that end with the real time of the request. The inspector's Mandate snapshot shows the dates.
